extension.description: A dark, cinematic Kodi skin with glass panels, large backdrops and rows for Trakt continue watching, trending titles, your library and your liked Trakt lists (via Seren).
Een donkere, cinematische Kodi-skin met glazen panelen, grote achtergronden en rijen voor Trakt verder kijken, trending titels, je bibliotheek en je Trakt-lijsten (via Seren).
extension.news: 1.31.45: Home navigation: a poster row at the top can be reached again with Up (it was skipped); Down on the bottom row goes to the top row and Up on the top row to the bottom; Back in a row goes to its first item, then to the top row, then to the menu. 1.31.44: Clean-up: unused texts, leftover settings variables and an unused Home expression removed; nothing changes for you. 1.31.43: Streaming services: a click on a service in the row now opens a pop-up with its six lists under each other (new, popular and top rated movies and series) and the title under the cursor above them; OK opens the title, Back closes. The service's transparent logo shows at the top and on Home. 1.31.42: Streaming services: add a row > Lucent fast lists (TMDb) > Streaming services: a row with the services of your country (a click opens the service with new, popular and top rated movies and series), or one list of one service as its own row. The subtitle list that opened by itself closes after 20 seconds when you do nothing. 1.31.41: "Check for updates now" (and the automatic check) now updates every add-on from the Lucent repository that you have installed, also the ones without "lucent" in their name (like the Seren repository) and the ones installed from a zip, which Kodi itself does not update. 1.31.40: Player menu: on the progress bar Left / Right now jump 10 seconds back / forward and Down goes to the buttons (the bar used to ignore Left / Right and keep Down). Subtitle list: only the film's subtitles in your languages are listed, the others behind "Other languages in the film"; the language pill is black on the white bar; Right from the list reaches the scrollbar. With Lucent Subtitles 1.0.1 the list no longer stops internet streams. 1.31.39: Subtitle list: at the top you can now switch subtitles on or off and pick a subtitle stream inside the film, above the subtitles found online. It opens by itself after 5 seconds (still without pausing). The subtitle button in the player menu now opens this list; the separate search button is gone. 1.31.38: Home rows no longer jump: a row is shown steadily as soon as Lucent Library has a filled copy (no more timed flashes). Subtitle list: when it opens by itself it waits until the film really plays (15 s) and no longer pauses it (a pause right at the start made Seren restart the film); it closes when the video stops and can always be opened again. Tested 3 times in a real Kodi. 1.31.37: Home rows: a row that was empty once (for example because its list was still being fetched) was hidden for good, because Kodi only reads the list of a visible row. Now a row is shown as soon as Lucent Library has a filled copy, and all rows read their list again after a tab switch. Tested in a real Kodi: before, a fresh Home stayed empty; now every filled row appears, an empty one stays hidden. 1.31.36: Self-test lists the rows of every tab with their state (fetched, waiting, failed). 1.31.35: On CoreELEC and LibreELEC the box's own settings (network, Bluetooth, updates) now show in Settings > System and can be added to the side menu. 1.31.34: Light mode (auto-on for boxes with 2 GB, builds only 6 Home rows) now has its own switch in Settings > Skin settings and rebuilds Home at once; the self-test lists every Home row with its state (fetched, waiting, failed). 1.31.33: A trailer started from the film or series page now goes full screen when Kodi left it playing behind the page. 1.31.32: Skin settings no longer has its own "About" page (it is in the main settings menu): About Lucent is now a pop-up, and the new-version pop-up switch moved to Settings > About. 1.31.31: Settings tidied: "About" now only has Lucent, news, updates and licences; Setup assistant moved to Skin settings; Back-up and kids mode to Files and profiles; Self-test and safe log to System info. 1.31.30: Lucent's own Home rows (TMDb and Trakt): no more error from The Movie Database when you click a title (the page opens straight away), plus logos, genres, runtime and vote counts on the cards. 1.31.29: Your Trakt lists are fast now too: add a row, "Lucent fast lists (TMDb)" > "Trakt lists (fast)": watchlist, recommended for you, trending, anticipated, or one of your own / liked lists. Needs you to be logged in to Trakt in Seren. 1.31.28: New Home row source: "Lucent fast lists (TMDb)" when you add a row (trending, popular, top rated, in cinemas, coming soon, series on air). They come straight from TMDb through Lucent Library, are saved and shown at once, and do not start Seren or any other add-on. A click opens the title's page; Play goes to Seren. Needs the TMDb key (Seren's, or your own in Skin settings). 1.31.27: On-screen keyboard: OK on a letter no longer closes the keyboard (remotes such as CoreELEC send OK as the Enter key, which Lucent had set to Done). Use the Done button to finish. 1.31.26: Hide channels: new "Hide adult groups" (recognised by name: xxx, adult, porn, erotic ...); you see the groups first and confirm. 1.31.25: Hide channels, quick option: short words such as NL only match as a word ("(NL) Sport", "|NL|") and no longer inside other words (Finland, Online). 1.31.24: Replay (catch-up): stop a programme halfway and open it again later, and Lucent asks whether to carry on where you stopped (no answer = carry on). 1.31.23: Settings > Live TV > Hide channels: leave out groups (for example everything except NL, BE and sport) or a single channel you never watch. Lucent saves a shorter list for IPTV Simple, builds it again every day, and "Show everything again" puts the original back. 1.31.22: Live TV menu: new star button (next to the moon) adds the channel you watch to Kodi favourites, or removes it again. 1.31.21: Automatic weekly backup: Settings > About > Backup and restore > Automatic weekly backup. Choose a folder (best a USB stick); once a week Lucent saves a backup there and keeps the last 4. 1.31.20: The goal notification switch (Settings > Live TV) was missing; it is there now. 1.31.19: Goal notifications: when a team you follow in Sport scores, a pop-up shows the score and the minute (not when you already watch that game with the score bar). Switch on/off in Settings > Live TV. 1.31.18: The Self-test and Safe log buttons were missing on the About page; they are there now (below Kids mode). 1.31.17: Settings > About: Self-test (checks Seren, Lucent Library, Lucent Subtitles, IPTV Simple, channels and says what is missing) and Safe log (a copy of the Kodi log with logins, passwords, tokens and the provider address blanked out, safe to share). 1.31.16: Live match clock now sits in its own box: above the score card and as its own pill in the info bar (no longer cramped under the score). 1.31.15: Score bar and Sport: when a club colour is white or very light (Groningen) the second club colour is used, so names and scores can be read. 1.31.14: Sport also reads the guide of NPO 1, 2 and 3 (football on the public channels). 1.31.13: Sport reads the TV guide of the sport channels only (recognised by channel and group name: Ziggo Sport, ESPN, Sky Sports, DAZN, Viaplay, beIN, Eurosport, TNT, F1, UFC, golf, tennis and many more) instead of every channel in your IPTV list - much faster and lighter on a 2 GB box. When fewer than three sport channels are recognised, all channels are read as before. 1.31.12: Xtream login: requests now carry the full set of browser headers (some panels answer 884 or Access denied without them) and compressed answers are understood; when the API gives no channels the message shows the answer per call. 1.31.11: Xtream login without get.php: when the panel refuses the channel list link, Lucent builds the list itself through the panel's API (the way the IPTV apps do: categories, channel numbers, logos, guide ids and replay per channel), gives it to IPTV Simple as a local file and refreshes it once a day; the guide link and the streams use the identification the panel accepts. No extra add-on needed. 1.31.10: Xtream login: panels that only talk to the apps they know are tried as TiviMate, IPTV Smarters and okhttp too (login and channel list); the login message shows the server's answer (for example Access denied). 1.31.9: Xtream login: when the provider refuses the channel list, Lucent tries the ways providers are picky about (asking as VLC, a browser or Kodi; list type m3u_plus or m3u; ts or m3u8), shows the HTTP answer, and gives IPTV Simple the exact variant that worked. 1.31.8: Xtream login: Lucent first fetches the channel list from the provider itself and tells you how many channels it holds; when IPTV Simple then still shows nothing, the message quotes what IPTV Simple wrote in the log (logins blanked out). 1.31.7: Xtream login: IPTV Simple is restarted properly (wait until it has really stopped, switch on again with retries, wait for the first channels and show how many came in); the old channel and guide caches are cleared; when the channels still do not come in you are offered a Kodi restart. 1.31.6: Xtream IPTV: fill in the server address, user name and password of your provider (setup assistant > Live TV > Xtream login, or Settings > Live TV > Xtream login); Lucent checks the login with the server, writes the channel list and guide links into IPTV Simple Client, switches on replay (catch-up) and restarts the add-on. An existing list can be replaced or kept next to it. 1.31.5: Faster start: the start-up jobs (key maps, rating logos, Calendar/Sport tabs, the helper) run in one Python start instead of six at once, and the helper is no longer started again every time you return to Home. 18 unused fonts removed (less memory). Light mode now also asks Seren for small artwork (a third of the picture memory; your own choice is put back when you switch it off). Themes: the second line of a focused row in the TV windows, select lists and the event log followed the dark default and was unreadable on Ocean, Crimson and Graphite - it now follows the theme (new colour on_focus2). All fixed red/green/amber/dim colours now use the theme tokens. 1.31.4: Setup assistant: Install Seren now works on a new installation - Seren is not in Kodi's own repository, so Lucent first installs Seren's repository (Nixgates, now offered through the Lucent repository) and then Seren. Home can no longer lose the focus (for example after closing the setup on a new installation, or OK on a Home tab without rows): the menu gets the focus back within two seconds. 1.31.3: Home rows from add-ons load reliably (with Lucent Library 1.7.0): Kodi no longer starts Seren ten times at once when a tab opens - the rows show their saved copy at once and are fetched one by one in the background; rows are no longer all reloaded each time a video starts or stops. 1.31.2: Subtitle list: when it stays empty (or while it is still searching) you are no longer stuck - the focus sits on the buttons, so Close, Search yourself and Subtitles off always work; the first results take the focus into the list. 1.31.1: Sport: Back while watching a game full screen makes the channel small again in the TV window on the Sport page, from every place you can start one (game page, game list, club card and team card) - before, the channel kept playing in the background behind the page. 1.31.0 - Beta 1: the first beta. Every scroll bar in the skin now looks and works the same: same thin bar everywhere (the TV guide had its own), lists that could run past their edge got one (Sport, calendar, subtitle list, settings, file manager, context menu, profiles, TV guide groups, guide search), Right from a list goes to its bar and Left back (the select list paged instead, System info could not be scrolled); long texts (plots, info, setup steps) all scroll by themselves the same way; the live TV channel buttons and the guide favourite button follow your theme colour. 1.30.136: "OK on a film opens the page" now really works in the video lists (your library, Seren folders): Lucent's key file used a window name Kodi does not know, so Kodi ignored it and OK kept playing. 1.30.135: A4KSubtitles is gone from Lucent: settings, setup assistant, backup and credits now only use Lucent Subtitles; the subtitle list only asks Lucent Subtitles; A4KSubtitles is switched off once so its own automatic search no longer pops up (you can uninstall it). 1.30.134: Sport: games that are already over are no longer shown (All games, My sport); only live and upcoming games. 1.30.133: Lucent Subtitles, our own subtitle add-on (installed with this update and made the default instead of A4KSubtitles): asks OpenSubtitles, SubDL and Podnapisi at the same time with a time limit, puts subtitles that fit your exact video first (file hash and release name), finds season packs, and saves everything as UTF-8 so accents show correctly. Fill in your free OpenSubtitles and SubDL keys via the setup assistant (Subtitles > Accounts and keys) or Skin settings > Integrations > Subtitle add-on settings. 1.30.132: Sport loads much faster: games from before today are no longer fetched, and only today is asked again every 15 minutes (later days every 6 hours) instead of all two weeks each time. Settings > About: the list now scrolls along to the last item and has a scroll bar. 1.30.131: Library rows on Home (Lucent Library 1.6.5): OK or Info on a film or episode opens its info page again. 1.30.130: Sleep timer (moon button in the player menu): stop after this episode or film, or after 15-90 minutes. Kids mode with a PIN (Skin settings > Kids mode): only the side-menu items you choose, no Options on the info page, settings behind the PIN. Backup and restore (Skin settings > Backup and restore): your settings, menu and logins in one zip, and back. Setup assistant: new steps Playback (buffer advice for your box, refresh rate, surround passthrough) and Backup. Light mode now does not build rows 7-10 at all (the skin reloads once when you switch it). Skin settings open faster (a third fewer controls, looks the same). The Sport and TV guide windows follow your theme colour for the focus. 1.30.129: Options > Remove from library now also works for an episode or a whole season (with Lucent Library 1.6.4 it stays out for good). 1.30.128: Options on the info page: the menu opens small in the middle of the screen, and Back steps back one level at a time (pictures > picture types > Options menu > page). 1.30.127: Questions with a long text (like the update pop-up) can be scrolled: press Up from the buttons to reach the scroll bar. 1.30.126: The setup assistant is now also at the bottom of the Skin settings menu. 1.30.125: Setup assistant: the first time Lucent opens it walks through Seren and Trakt, the TMDb key, live TV (IPTV Simple), subtitles, Lucent Library and the look, showing how each stands with a button to set it up. Open it again via Settings > About > Setup assistant. 1.30.124: Live TV: the star button above the guide's groups opens a list of all groups to choose the one that always opens first (before, only the top group could become the favourite). 1.30.123: Options > Choose art: the list moves left and a big preview of the focused picture sits next to it. 1.30.122: TV > Group management: new buttons Hide all groups and Show all groups ('All channels' stays visible so the guide always has something to show). 1.30.121: Info page: the Trailer and Rating buttons are gone; instead Options for library titles: edit title, edit sort title, choose art, remove from library (a Lucent Library title is also removed from your Trakt collection, otherwise it would come back). 1.30.120: Alphabet bar under the poster rows of films and series (Posters view, sorted A-Z by title or name): the current letter lights up; press Down to reach it, Left/Right to pick a letter and OK to jump there. With other sort orders Down pages as before. 1.30.119: TV (IPTV): Kodi could hang or crash on Manage groups - Lucent had no such window. Lucent now has all of Kodi's TV windows in its own style: group manager, channel manager, programme and recording info, guide search, guide controls, the channel and programme lists while watching, and the Channels, Recordings, Timers, Search and Providers screens. 1.30.118: The updater now covers everything from Lucent you have installed (skin, Lucent Library, screensaver, repository, and anything added later), with all updates in one pop-up; the skin is updated last, Lucent Library restarts with its new version and is not replaced while it is writing your library. 1.30.117: Scores for the library: films and series from the Kodi library (Lucent Library 1.6.2) show the same IMDb and Trakt scores as with Seren, also on the season page (a library season has no score of its own, so Lucent shows the series' scores); without IMDb or Trakt, the TMDB score is shown. 1.30.116: Lighter Home screen: which row is shown is worked out once per frame instead of in hundreds of long conditions (84% less condition work), and the 21 backdrops behind the rows are now one picture that cross-fades by itself (fewer large pictures in memory). Home looks exactly the same. 1.30.115: Big clean-up, lighter and steadier: the background helper does its slow internet work separately so the poster glow and subtitle swap never wait, no second helper can start and a skin update hands over cleanly; unanswered pop-ups close after a minute so reminders and recordings keep going; the calendar asks a few shows per round and reads your Trakt collection even before you follow anything; lists are saved safely; the TV 'switch to full screen' setting always keeps your own value; the F1 circuit drawing is really saved; a short network problem is no longer remembered as 'no colour'; the subtitle list cannot open twice and old synced files are tidied; less memory and fewer hitches (guide not kept in memory, media windows only build their own views, remote logos load in the background, stats drawn once, 115 unused images removed); small fixes and translations. 1.30.114: Subtitles in sync: a subtitle that is not marked in sync is lined up with one that is (any language) - the shift and a wrong frame rate are fixed by comparing when the lines start, like the tool alass. Automatic (Skin settings > Integrations > Subtitles) or with the new Sync button in the live list. 1.30.113: Lucent Library: first load your whole collection in Seren (Movies > My movies (collection) and TV shows > My shows (collection)) until everything is in - Lucent Library only takes over what Seren already knows. This is now also explained in Skin settings > Integrations > Lucent Library. 1.30.112: Subtitles: the pause screen no longer lies over the subtitle search or other pop-ups; when Kodi's own subtitle search opens (for example by A4KSubtitles' automatic search) Lucent's live list takes its place; the live list has a Search yourself button. 1.30.111: (1) Live subtitle list: the subtitle button in the player (and automatic search) opens a Lucent list that asks every subtitle add-on at the same time and fills as each one answers; languages by full name, yours first, then subtitles in sync with the video; every row says where it comes from; the film pauses while you choose. (2) AI subtitles: with your own free Google Gemini key, a row Translate with AI translates the best English subtitle into your language, starting where you are watching; the rest follows in the background and the translation is kept for next time. Skin settings > Integrations > Subtitles. 1.30.110: Home: Back in the Tonight for you row and the Sport row jumps to the first card, and from there to the menu, like the other rows. 1.30.109: Library and lists: when Trakt refuses one choice, the message names it (Library, Watchlist or the list) and shows what Trakt says about your account (VIP and limit); the other choices are still saved. 1.30.108: Trakt messages now say what really went wrong (Trakt's code with an explanation, no connection, or the error itself) instead of only "Trakt does not respond"; a personal Trakt list that fails is skipped instead of stopping Library and lists. 1.30.107: Trakt (Library and lists, watched, Tonight for you, Lucent Bibliotheek, screensaver): Lucent now uses the same Trakt app key as your Seren. Newer Seren versions (3.9.x) have their own key; Lucent still used the old one, so Trakt refused the login (code 401) although Seren was logged in fine. 1.30.106: When Trakt no longer accepts Seren's login (and Seren cannot renew it), the message shows Trakt's code and has a button Link again now that opens Seren's own Trakt link (a code for trakt.tv/activate). 1.30.105: Trakt login expired: when Seren's Trakt login has run out, Lucent now lets Seren renew it (a quick sync in the background) and tries again, instead of asking you to open Seren. Also in Lucent Bibliotheek 1.5.1. 1.30.104: Lucent Bibliotheek 1.5.0 is built into the skin: (1) Library and lists > Library puts a title on Trakt and in the Kodi library at once (no waiting for the next sync), and taking it out removes it straight away. (2) New Home rows from the Kodi library: Continue watching, Next episode, Series with new episodes, New in your collection (+ Add widget > Kodi library). (3) Series you watch show how many episodes you have not seen yet on the poster. (4) Skin settings > Integrations > Lucent Library: counts, last update, Update now, update automatically every 6/12/24 hours, watched marks to Trakt, Surprise me. (5) A film collection shows how many films you have seen, and Watch the next one in the side menu. (6) Side menu in film / series lists: quick filters (not watched, genre, year, shorter than 2 hours, newly added) and Surprise me. (7) A watched mark you set in Kodi goes to Trakt too. 1.30.103: Series page for series in Kodi's own library (Lucent Bibliotheek): Library and lists and Continue now find the series by asking Kodi for its TMDB / IMDb / Trakt number (a season in the library has none of its own). 1.30.102: Series page: Library and lists now takes the series from the season tabs (it said the title had no Trakt or TMDB id). 1.30.101: Series page: the Continue button is only white when you are on it, like the other buttons. 1.30.100: Series page: the season summary capsule now grows and shrinks with its text and sits at the right edge. 1.30.99: Series page: the season summary at the right is wider so the watched count fits; the season tabs are a little narrower. 1.30.98: Series page: the season summary (season, number of episodes, how many watched) now sits in its own dark capsule at the right, clearly apart from the season tabs, with brighter text and the watched count in green. 1.30.97: New view Showcase for films, series and episodes: big 16:9 cards with the title logo over the picture, season and episode, duration, a progress bar and a watched check; below the row the status, year, scores, age rating, genre and story of the chosen title. Choose it in the side menu (Left) under View. 1.30.96: New view for series: opening a series shows one page with the logo, status, scores and story, the buttons Continue / Library and lists / More info, the seasons as tabs and the episodes of the chosen season as wide cards (watched check, progress bar, duration and date). Up chooses a season, OK plays via Seren. Switch: Skin settings > Layout > Info page > Series: seasons as tabs. 1.30.95: The scores on Home are back for the kept rows: Lucent Bibliotheek 1.4.1 reads the ratings per site (IMDb, Trakt, TMDB, Rotten Tomatoes) and the status from Seren, and when a title only has one general score it is shown with a star. 1.30.94: One background helper for everyone: calendar, sport, updates, Tonight for you, poster colour and automatic subtitles now run in a single Python process instead of six, which saves memory and makes start-up lighter. 1.30.93: Home: new info lines in the style of Arctic Fuse - the ratings of IMDb, Trakt, TMDB and Rotten Tomatoes (with your own logos, or fetch them from the Lucent GitHub page in Skin settings > Layout > Rating logos), and a line with a status label (ENDED / CONTINUING / CANCELLED / COMING / RELEASED), the date, season and episode, how far you are and when it is done. 1.30.92: Faster and steadier Home rows: (1) the rows are kept (through Lucent Bibliotheek 1.4.0, now installed with the skin): Home shows the last rows at once and refreshes them in the background; a row that comes back empty keeps its last content, an empty answer is tried once more, and Continue watching is refreshed a few seconds after you stop a video. (2) Only the top three rows load at start, the rest when you scroll down. Both can be switched off in Skin settings > Layout > Home screen. 1.30.91: Tonight for you: the title logo of the film or series is shown on top (from TMDB), like in the other rows. 1.30.90: Light mode for boxes with 2 GB of memory or less (switched on by itself once; Skin settings > Advanced): one background helper instead of four, at most 6 rows per tab, no falling snow and no poster colour. For everyone: the Home screen no longer starts its helper scripts again every time you come back to it, and the subtitle helper only runs when automatic subtitle search is on. 1.30.89: Colour from the poster now shows on Home (a dark fade at the bottom of Home covered it); the helper keeps running after an error and writes the chosen colour in the log. 1.30.88: (1) Home: the hero shows how far you are in a film or episode you are watching and when it will be done if you go on now. (2) Intro at start: the Lucent moon rises with a glow (Skin settings > Appearance). (3) Tonight for you: a row on Home with titles like what you watched last on Trakt, fitting the time of day (series in the morning and at the weekend, films in the evening), Because you watched ... (Skin settings > Layout > Home screen). (4) Pop-up when a film from your Trakt collection or watchlist comes out digitally, with where to watch it (Skin settings > Tracking). (5) Who is watching? screen with the Lucent moon and a glow in your colour; every profile keeps its own colour theme. (6) Seasons: Halloween, Sinterklaas, Christmas with falling snow, New Year and King's Day get a small badge at the logo and a soft glow on Home (Skin settings > Appearance). 1.30.87: (1) Info page: Watch on - the streaming services where the film or series is available in your country (Netflix, Videoland, ...), with their logos (TMDB / JustWatch). (2) The background glows softly in the colour of the poster you are on, and flows to the next colour as you move (switch: Skin settings > Appearance > Colour from the poster). (3) Sport today on Home: when a team you follow plays today a card with both clubs, the time or the live score and the channel appears above the rows; OK watches the channel (switch: Skin settings > Layout > Home screen). 1.30.86: What is new now opens a pop-up with the changes of every version (in Settings > About and in Skin settings > About). 1.30.85: Skin settings > About: Licences and credits now opens in a pop-up. 1.30.84: Settings: new item About at the bottom of the list, with the Lucent logo, version, check for updates, automatic updates, what is new and a button that opens the full About page of Skin settings. 1.30.83: Skin settings > About in the style of Nuvio: the Lucent logo with who made it, the version of Lucent and Kodi, the update options (moved here from Integrations: pop-up, check now, automatic updates by Kodi, what is new), Lucent on GitHub and a list of licences and credits that folds open. 1.30.82: Skin settings: you can move through the rows on the right again (Up / Down / Left / Right did nothing in 1.30.81). 1.30.81: Settings in the style of Nuvio: Kodi Settings now has the categories on the left and on the right a title with explanation and rows with an icon and a short explanation that open the right part of the Kodi settings at once; Kodi settings pages and Skin settings got the same look; in Skin settings every row has an icon and an explanation, and the long categories (Layout, Integrations) have sections that fold open and shut (Closed / Open). 1.30.80: Back no longer visits the same actor page twice: a chain left over from an earlier time is forgotten when you start from a film page you opened yourself, and going back to a page already in the chain continues from there. 1.30.79: Back from a title opened from another page (actor, studio, similar titles, collection) really goes back now: the new page is opened alongside, so Lucent keeps watching and reopens the page you came from (before it lost track and you landed on Home). 1.30.78: Back follows the whole chain: film page > actor (or studio) > film > Back brings you to the actor page, Back again to the film page you opened the actor from, and so on. 1.30.77: Back to the previous film page: the page you leave is now remembered when it loads (instead of asked from the screen later), a closing pop-up no longer cancels the way back, and the trailer buttons also end the chain. 1.30.76: info page: click a studio under Production to see its logo, where it is from and its most popular films and series (from TMDB); a title there opens its page. 1.30.75: Back from a title page that was opened from another page (similar titles, collection, actor / director films) brings you to the page you came from instead of Home; Play or the trailer ends that chain. 1.30.74: a title clicked under Similar titles, in the collection or among the films of an actor / director now opens its page at once, built from TMDB data (Play goes to Seren); when that is not possible it falls back to the earlier way (open the Seren list and press Info). 1.30.73: info page and person page: a title you click under Similar titles, in the collection, or among the films of an actor / director now opens its own film or series page (before it played, or opened Seren search results). 1.30.72: info page: a title under Similar titles now opens its own page (it started playing); without your own TMDB key a note tells you where to enter it. 1.30.71: the scroll bar on the right works again in the file browser, add-on settings, scraper settings, Settings, Skin settings, event log, video versions, subtitles and colour picker: press Right to get on the bar (Up/Down then scroll a page at a time), Right again goes on to the buttons, Left comes back to the list;
